description: Norsk Titanium AS, together with its subsidiaries, engages in 3D printing of metal alloys for commercial aerospace, defense, and industrial manufacturers in Europe and the United States. The company offers aerospace-grade, 3D-printed, structural titanium parts through its Rapid Plasma Deposition technology. It also provides value-added parts. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Hønefoss, Norway.
